scope: Only data/parsed/*.parquet in this checkout; first 5,000 characters of every text row, not a sampled set of rows.
reader: fastparquet page decoder retaining only 5,000-character string prefixes; PyArrow metadata/ID cross-check
regex_notes: Supplied regex counts one row per iteration, including UNKNOWN. It truncates form labels at spaces (e.g. SCHEDULE 13G/A becomes SCHEDULE). Full-label counts preserve spaces. These per-type totals include duplicate IDs.
resource_notes: One isolated worker per row group releases page buffers; entire process tree capped at 2 GiB, no swap, one CPU core.
prefix_decoder_crosscheck: The prefix reader matched PyArrow text[:5000] exactly for all 2,000 rows of January row group 0.
